Let me analyze this conflict.

Axis: num
- Register: "R060/2000-NL1-2012.02 Rev. 1"
- Document: "R60/2000-NL1-12-02"

The certificate document text shows: "Number R60/2000-NL1-12-02 Revision 1" but the extracted comment says "num: R060/2000-NL1-2012.02 Rev. 1".

Both refer to the same OIML certificate under R60/2000 recommendation, issued by NL1 (Netherlands), certificate number 2012.02 / 12-02, revision 1. The register form is "R060/2000-NL1-2012.02 Rev. 1" — note the "R060" vs "R60" difference (zero-padded), and "2012.02" vs "12-02" (year abbreviation difference), and "Rev. 1" vs "Revision 1".

These are number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate. Per rules: "Number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate = same-entity with the register's canonical form."

So verdict: same-entity, best_value = register's canonical form "R060/2000-NL1-2012.02 Rev. 1".

Why: Both denote the same R60/2000 NL1 certificate 2012.02 rev 1; only formatting (zero-padding, year abbreviation, Rev. vs Revision) differs, so use register canonical form.
